The '''Jedi Trials chamber''' was a large room that was located within the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a place for potential [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to be administered the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]], a specialized program could project simulacrums of various Jedi and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to challenge the skills of a Jedi.

==History==
Erected within the Temple Ziggurat, this chamber was destroyed and rebuilt several times in the Temple's long history, seeing completion in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In use for nearly a millennia after, the Trials Chambers served several generations of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] as they attempted to successfully join the ranks of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

Housing the largest [[Jedi academy]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the last millennia of the Old Republic, the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]] saw the need for a permanent area in which they could administer the Jedi Trials effectively and efficiently. Within this specialized chamber, Padawans ready to face the Trials would face a set of tests that would try their skills and spirit by pitting them against simulacrums of the most fierce Jedi and Sith ever to travel the galaxy.<ref name="TFU" />

While not all Trials were held in this chamber due to the number of students the Temple's academy produced and the different circumstances surrounding each apprentice's knighting, throughout the centuries, the Temple elevated several thousand Knights.<ref name="TFU" />

At the end of the violent [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic which the Jedi had served for so long was dissolved and transformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Temple was placed under martial law by decree of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], stormed the Temple and executed its occupants, damaging the Temple in the process. The Temple's Trial Chamber escaped with only a few blaster-burns and toppled statues but was structurally sound.<ref name="TFU" />

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], with a small contingent of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] still occupying the Temple, Darth Vader [[Starkiller's Trial of Skill|sent]] his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], to the Temple in order to complete the [[Jedi Trials/Legends#Trial of Skill|Trial of Skill]]. Having passed through the stormtrooper-guarded [[Jedi Temple/Legends|entry hall]], Starkiller made his way deep into the Temple where he located the Trials Chamber. Upon entering the room the old Trials Program activated and the simulacrum of [[Darth Desolous]] stalked out of the shadows and engaged the assassin in a duel. After an exhausting lightsaber fight, Starkiller used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to topple the statue of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] which had been installed at the far end of the chamber. The Trial passed, Starkiller left the Temple with a new [[Second mission to Raxus Prime|mission]] from his master.<ref name="TFU" />

A few weeks after the duel in the chamber took place, the hall leading down to the chamber collapsed, leaving the room inaccessible. The Hall would stand in silence for several more decades, collecting dust and slowly crumbling. When Darth Sidious and Vader were slain, the Empire lost balance and was eventually [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|ousted]] from Coruscant by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] Coruscant was devastated by [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]], causing the Temple to crumble and reveal parts of the foundation.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref> When the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] reclaimed the world, [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]], ordered the [[Reconstruction Authority]] to [[New Jedi Temple|rebuild]] the ancient edifice as a gift for the great sacrifices made by the [[New Jedi Order|reformed Order]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. While the structure was rebuilt using blueprints of the old building, it is unknown if the Trials Chamber was reconstructed or replaced.<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

==Layout and style==
Located deep in the Temple Ziggurat, this high-ceiling chamber was constructed out of a dark stone and was dimly lit. Located off an ancient passage way, this doorless hall consisted of several stepped areas lined with stone and [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] statues of Jedi Masters long dead. Within the architecture of the room, the Jedi Trials Program was stored, capable of constructed simulacrums of ancient warriors capable of dueling and injuring Padawans sent to defeat them.<ref name="TFU" />

Upon the fall of the Order, this room was opened for touring by the Emperor, who would bring the elite of Coruscant inside to view the downfall of the Jedi. Within the Trials chamber, Palpatine had erected a massive statue of himself depicting his dominance over the Jedi.<ref name="TFU" />
